name: memdot
description: Long-term memory for coding agents: encrypted on your device, stored on Portaldot V3, and yours to move or revoke.

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: Only if you'd rather paste a key than run the login skill. A key alone reaches Assisted namespaces, not Private ones.

namespace.title: Namespace (optional)
namespace.description: Where memories go. Login sets this for you.

user_id.title: Your memory id (optional)
user_id.description: Keeps your preferences together across machines. Defaults to your account name here.

top_k.title: Results per search
top_k.description: How many memories a search returns.

max_context_chars.title: Most text to recall
max_context_chars.description: The most memory text added to a conversation at once.

search_scope.title: What a search reaches
search_scope.description: repo: this repository plus your own preferences. mine: everything of yours. all: the whole namespace.

checkpoint_exchanges.title: Save after this many turns
checkpoint_exchanges.description: Each save uses a model call and a chain write. Whatever's left also saves at compaction and at the end of a session.

auto_save.title: Save automatically
auto_save.description: Turn off to save only when asked.
